generalCriterionList.description: Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs
The cost of the Tender form shall not be refundable.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

As per Karnataka state Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund/ etc., applies to latest order available
All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the tenderer in complete manner otherwise it will be rejected.
All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Commissioner, CMC Harihara reserves the right to verify the documents before approval.
The employer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons as per standard tender document clause 22
The tenderer should maintain the work during the defective liability period for up to 2 years from Completion

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: PWD Contractors Registration Certificate Class-4 and above

Tenderer in his name should have achieved in at least Two financial year an average financial turnover in all classes of civil engineering construction works only for Rs.9.80 lakhs in last five years i.e. 2021-22 TO 2025-26 With UDIN Number.
Contractor Should submit PAN, GST, Phone number, Address and Emai-ID for communication
Details of existing commitments and on going works as per Standard Tender Documents Section 3.1.5 A Proforma
Profit Loss statement and and Balance Sheet of Last Three Years i.e from the year 2021-22 TO 2025-26 Certified by the Auditors.
